# Campaign 1 Blurb

*What a new player may know before the first session.*

It is September 2001 and New York belongs to the Camarilla, at least on paper. Two years ago the sect took the city in a long, ugly war, and the Kindred who did the fighting are still here, still armed, and still owed. The Prince who has kept the peace since then is a Nosferatu called Calebros, and he has let it be known that he would like to stop.

You are newly Embraced, or close enough that nobody takes you seriously yet. Your sire has secured you an invitation to the masquerade ball that Rene Valentine throws every autumn in a Chelsea gallery. Everyone who matters will be there. So will everyone who wants to matter.

## Making your character

Think about:

- what you looked like and what you did when you were alive,
- the night of your Embrace and who was there,
- two things you fear and two things you want,
- the first taste of blood,
- your sire, and whether you trust them.

Your character should be a fledgling or neonate who is Camarilla-aligned, or who can at least pass for it at a party.
